article.title: Biological and mechanistic pathways of cardiometabolic multiple long-term conditions.
article.abstract: Cardiometabolic multiple long-term conditions (MLTC) arise from the complex interplay of biological, sociodemographic, environmental, and behavioural factors across the life course. Shared risk factors and mechanisms, including insulin resistance, adiposity, and chronic inflammation, underpin its development. Growing evidence also implicates that even low-level, long-term exposure to fine particulate matter, nitrogen dioxide, and related pollutants can accelerate the trajectory of cardiometabolic MLTC. Early-life exposures, including undernutrition and overnutrition, altered gut microbiome, and endocrine-disrupting chemicals, interact with social determinants of health to aggravate inflammatory and metabolic dysregulation. These mechanisms, together with genetic susceptibility, epigenetic modifications, and multiomics perturbations, shape disease progression, heterogeneity, and the clustering of cardiometabolic MLTC. Yet, fundamental gaps persist, whereby most mechanistic insights are derived from single-disease studies, leaving the temporal hierarchy, causal pathways, and population-level heterogeneity largely unresolved. Addressing these challenges will require life-course research, integrative systems approaches, and translational studies that link mechanistic insights to precision prevention and therapeutic strategies. By bridging discovery with actions, such efforts can enhance care for cardiometabolic MLTC and promote equitable health outcomes globally.

score.summary_kr: 본 논문은 심장대사 다중 장기질환(MLTC)의 생물학적 및 기전적 경로를 체계적으로 검토한 리뷰 논문입니다. 인슐린 저항성, 비만, 만성염증 등의 공유 위험인자와 함께 미세먼지, 이산화질소 등 환경오염물, 조기노출(영양부족/과잉, 장내미생물, 내분비교란물질) 등이 심장대사질환 군집화에 미치는 영향을 다룹니다. 유전적 감수성, 후성유전학적 변화, 다중오믹스 교란이 질병 진행과 이질성을 형성하는 메커니즘을 강조하며, 생애과정 연구와 통합 시스템 접근법을 통한 정밀예방 및 치료전략 개발의 필요성을 제시합니다.
key_points: 당뇨·심혈관질환 등 심장대사 만성질환의 공유 생물학적 메커니즘 (인슐린 저항성, 만성염증, 비만)
다중오믹스, 후성유전학, 유전적 감수성을 포함한 통합 분석 강조
환경노출(대기오염, 조기영양), 장내미생물, 사회건강결정요인의 상호작용 규명
score.reason: MFDS 과제의 핵심(다중오믹스 통합, 만성대사질환, 정밀의료)과 직접 부합하며, 당뇨·심혈관·대사질환의 메커니즘과 위험인자를 광범위하게 다루나 구체적 예측모델이나 코호트 데이터 활용보다는 이론적 리뷰 성격으로 점수는 8점.
